sections.title: Background section
sections.summary: Sets the full-screen backdrop behind everything on this screen — a solid color, a photo, or a looping video. It is the first thing a visitor sees, so match it to the theme and keep enough contrast for the header and buttons to stay readable.

sections.title: Where it appears
sections.summary: Covered screen types: HeroContent, Carousel, ListMultiPick, ListSinglePick, GridMultiPick, GridSinglePick, TextInput, WheelPicker, HeroList, WebEmbed, Paywall, FlexibleLayout.

sections.title: Tint The Phone's Top Bar
sections.summary: Sets the color of the surrounding system bars on web funnels, the strip at the top showing time and battery, and the bottom address bar. Leave it unset for almost every screen so it inherits your onboarding default. Set a color only when you want the phone's frame to blend into a full-bleed background for a seamless look.

sections.title: Full-Screen Background Photo
sections.summary: Uploads an image that fills the screen background when the background is set to Photo. It scales to cover the whole screen, so edges can get cropped on different phone sizes, keep your focal point centered. If you put text on top, choose a darker or dimmed image so your copy stays readable.

sections.title: Solid Background Fill
sections.summary: Sets the single color behind the whole screen when the background is a solid color. Defaults to white. Match it to your theme and ad creative, and keep it high-contrast against your text and buttons so everything stays easy to read on a phone.

sections.title: What Fills The Background
sections.summary: Chooses what sits behind your content: a solid color, a photo, or a video clip, and reveals the matching control below. Defaults to a solid color. Use solid for clean question screens, a photo for emotive intro screens, and video only for short high-impact openers, since heavy video slows loading and can lose paid-ad visitors.

sections.title: Full-Screen Background Video
sections.summary: Uploads a short clip that fills the screen background when the background is set to Video Clip; it loops on its own. Keep it brief and lightweight, large videos slow the first load and can lose paid-ad visitors before they engage. Make sure any text over it stays readable across the looping frames.
